purpose: The current limitations of the platform's Hughes 2019 implementation. The October limitations in hughes_parameter_extract_v1.json (kept unchanged, because locked reports pin that file) describe the state before the variability extract, the structure contract and population mode existed (AI review of 10 November, F15).
limitations: Parameters, between-patient variability (OMEGA block) and structure (eight first-order stages) were transcribed from the article and its supplementary control stream (hughes_variability_extract_v1.json, hughes_structure_contract_v1.json); an AI review on 10 November 2026 found them to match. No source data or NONMEM run outputs are available, so the fit itself cannot be reproduced.
Typical-value curves and a population band (between-patient variability) are computed; residual error is not simulated.
Parameter uncertainty is shown only as a lower bound from the published %RSE (population method v1.1).

The weight basis of the Cockcroft-Gault creatinine clearance is not stated in the article or supplement; the platform assumes ideal body weight and shows alternatives (hughes_weight_basis_assessment).
No efficacy or toxicity output; exposure-safety odds are a separate model.
